# Dr. Waqas Ahmad Awan - Best Child Surgeon & Child Specialist in Mian Channu & Multan

This is the official website for Dr. Waqas Ahmad Awan (MBBS, MS Pediatric Surgery), top-rated child surgeon, child specialist, and pediatric surgeon in Mian Channu and Multan, Pakistan. Also recognized as the leading Bachon Ka Doctor and Bachon Ka Surgeon at Al Manzoor Hospital Mian Channu.

## Core Specializations & Services
- Pediatric Surgery & Neonatal Surgery (بچوں اور نومولود کی سرجری)
- Pediatric Urology & Circumcision (خفتنہ / پیشاب کے امراض)
- Undescended Testes Surgery (Orchidopexy)
- Ventriculoperitoneal (VP) Shunting for Hydrocephalus (سر میں پانی کا علاج)
- Myelomeningocele (MMC) Repair / Spina Bifida (کمر کے پھوڑے کا علاج)
- Cleft Lip & Palate Repair (کٹے ہونٹ اور تالو کا علاج)
- Pediatric Hernia & Hydrocele Surgery
- Rectal Polyps & Intestinal Obstruction
- Umbilical Granuloma Treatment
